top_temples.name: Shri Govindajee Temple
top_temples.location_note: Imphal; the largest Vaishnava temple in Manipur, originally built in 1846 under Maharaja Nara Singh and rebuilt in 1876 by Maharaja Chandrakriti, visible from a distance for its golden domes.

top_temples.name: Shree Shree Bijoy Govindajee Temple
top_temples.location_note: Sagolband, Imphal West; considered by many to be the oldest temple in Manipur.

top_temples.name: Hanuman Thakur Temple
top_temples.location_note: Imphal; known for its vibrant festivals and religious ceremonies.

top_temples.name: ISKCON Temple, Imphal
top_temples.location_note: Imphal; visited by pilgrims from across the world.

top_temples.name: Pakhangba Temple, Kangla
top_temples.location_note: Within Kangla Fort in the heart of Imphal; a key symbol of Manipur's Meitei cultural and religious heritage.

top_temples.name: Bishnupur Vishnu Temple
top_temples.location_note: Bishnupur town; a 15th-century brick temple built by King Kyamba, now an ASI-protected monument that gives Bishnupur its name. (Note: this entry merges the dataset's duplicate 'Bishnupur' and 'Bishnupur (Vishnu Temple)' listings per the data-quality flag.)

top_temples.name: Konung Lairembi Temple
top_temples.location_note: Bishnupur; a distinct local shrine from the main Vishnu Temple.

top_temples.name: Jagannath Prabhu Temple, Churachandpur
top_temples.location_note: Churachandpur town; a historic Meitei Hindu temple documented as having stood for almost a century.

top_temples.name: Radha-Krishna Temple, Churachandpur
top_temples.location_note: Churachandpur town; a historic Vaishnavite temple serving the local Meitei Hindu community.

top_temples.name: Koubru Laikha Temple
top_temples.location_note: Listed as a place of interest by the Senapati district government; associated with Mount Koubru, whose deity Lainingthou Koubru is significant in Manipuri mythology, though the built shrine's exact location is given by some sources as neighbouring Imphal West district. No second distinct temple could be verified for Senapati despite repeated searches; this entry lists only one temple.

top_temples.name: Kali Mata Temple, Tamenglong
top_temples.location_note: Tamenglong town, a predominantly Zeliangrong Naga and Christian district; serves the local Hindu community and is cited as a symbol of the town's inter-faith harmony. No second distinct temple could be verified for Tamenglong despite repeated searches; this entry lists only one temple.

top_temples.name: Shyam Rai Temple, Thoubal
top_temples.location_note: Thoubal town; known for its masterful stone engravings.

top_temples.name: Pakhangba Temple, Thoubal
top_temples.location_note: Thoubal district; a sacred shrine distinct from the Pakhangba Temple within Kangla Fort in Imphal.
